name: blood-mission-qh-207
title: 血色使命I（淬火试炼）

war3campaign.w3a: A627 is a custom Absk ability named 切换背包 with hotkey F.
The ability swaps the active six-slot inventory with one alternate per hero.
war3campaign.w3u: Ten hero variants carry A627 in uabi.
c2.w3x: Jere and Kevin switch triggers use udg_a/udg_b and udg_c/udg_d.
tip7 also matches A627 and is disabled by the generic condition removal.
c7.w3x: A story transformation copies six item types from Jere to Jere2 without bridging extended backpack and equipment contents.
A later transformation removes A627 from Jere and adds it back with native UnitAddAbility.
c3.w3x: The authored intro removes Jere slots 0 and 1 instead of item IDs I62A and I629.
ALAS reorders inventory slots around B30B, so slot-based cleanup deletes the wrong items and leaves task items occupying the hero inventory.
c18.w3x: The finale removes Jere slot 0 as an implicit amulet removal, then adds I627.
This can delete B30B or another item if the inventory order changes.
movesword: Twelve chapters remove I625 and drop whatever item happens to occupy slot 1.
The intended moved item is I627; the replacement searches all inventory domains by item ID.

intentional_failure_paths_preserved: All non-backpack story triggers and quest progression
The c3 alternative branch that issues the berserk order before cleanup
Other abilities and non-task items on the affected hero unit objects
runtime_tests: Build from the clean 2.07 campaign with a new backpack enabled; confirm the authored 切换背包(F) command is absent on Jere, Kevin, and laotou.
Open the ALAS B30B backpack and confirm items can be added, moved, saved, and restored across a chapter transition.
Complete c2 and enter c3; confirm I62A and I629 are both removed and neither appears in Jere's inventory.
After c3 starts, confirm B30B remains in Jere's inventory and does not fall to the ground.
In c7, complete the story transformation and confirm B30B, 30-slot contents, equipment slots, and the authored backpack switch state are all preserved.
Trigger the later I625 movesword sequence and confirm only I627 falls to the ground.
In c18, confirm the amulet removal no longer deletes B30B or another slot-0 item.
Confirm non-backpack abilities and the campaign story continue normally.
